report.zh-Hans: 附来源链接的经营与资本报告

business.en: Silvaco supplies semiconductor process/device simulation (TCAD), electronic design automation (EDA), and semiconductor IP. Specialized simulation expertise and customer integration may differentiate it; acquisitions and project timing complicate organic-growth comparisons. Q2 2026 revenue was $17.806m, GAAP operating loss $3.999m, adjusted operating profit $0.635m, and derived operating cash outflow $5.502m. Improving adjusted earnings do not yet establish positive cash generation.
business.zh-Hans: Silvaco 提供半导体工艺／器件仿真（TCAD）、电子设计自动化（EDA）和半导体 IP。专业仿真技术和客户集成可能构成差异化优势；收购与项目时点使有机增长比较更复杂。2026 年第二季度收入为 1,780.6 万美元，GAAP 营业亏损为 399.9 万美元，调整后营业利润为 63.5 万美元，推算经营现金净流出为 550.2 万美元。调整后利润改善尚不能证明现金已实现净流入。

historyNote.en: USD millions. These are not five fully comparable cash-flow years. 2021 has an IPO operating summary but no cash-flow coverage; IPO/SBC and 2025 acquisitions/litigation create comparability breaks. 2016–2020 remain unobserved, with no backfill. A dash means unavailable, not zero.
historyNote.zh-Hans: 单位：百万美元。这并非五个完全可比的现金流年度。2021 年仅有 IPO 经营摘要，缺少现金流数据；IPO／股份支付以及 2025 年收购和诉讼导致可比性中断。2016–2020 年仍未观察到数据，未作回填。破折号代表缺失，不代表零。

guidanceTitle.en: Management guidance: five completed comparisons, one pending
guidanceTitle.zh-Hans: 管理层指引：五项已完成比较，一项待验证

guidanceNote.en: Two forecasts refer to the same FY2025 actual period; these are not five independent realized periods. Dated guidance is not an actual result. Prepared remarks, transcripts/Q&A and interviews were not reviewed.
guidanceNote.zh-Hans: 两次预测对应同一 2025 财年实际结果，并非五个独立的已实现期间。历史指引不是实际结果。未审阅预备讲稿、电话会文字稿／问答或访谈。

g1.en: March 5, 2025 → FY2025: revenue guidance 66–72 versus actual 63.064; bookings 72–79 versus 67.7; adjusted operating profit 2–7 versus −12.4. Material miss.
g1.zh-Hans: 2025 年 3 月 5 日 → 2025 财年：收入指引 66–72，实际 63.064；订单指引 72–79，实际 67.7；调整后营业利润指引 2–7，实际 −12.4。明显未达标。

g2.en: August 6, 2025 → FY2025: revised revenue 64–70 versus 63.064; bookings 67–74 versus 67.7; adjusted operating profit −2 to +1 versus −12.4. Revenue and profit missed; bookings met.
g2.zh-Hans: 2025 年 8 月 6 日 → 2025 财年：修订收入指引 64–70，实际 63.064；订单指引 67–74，实际 67.7；调整后营业利润指引 −2 至 +1，实际 −12.4。收入和利润未达标，订单达标。

g3.en: November 12, 2025 → Q4 2025: revenue 14–18 versus 18.252; bookings 15–19 versus 18.3; adjusted gross margin 78–82% versus 86%. Revenue and margin exceeded guidance.
g3.zh-Hans: 2025 年 11 月 12 日 → 2025 年第四季度：收入指引 14–18，实际 18.252；订单指引 15–19，实际 18.3；调整后毛利率指引 78–82%，实际 86%。收入和毛利率超过指引。

g4.en: March 12, 2026 → Q1 2026: revenue and bookings each 15–19 versus 17.755 and 17.2; adjusted gross margin about 85% versus 88%. Revenue/bookings met; margin exceeded.
g4.zh-Hans: 2026 年 3 月 12 日 → 2026 年第一季度：收入和订单指引均为 15–19，实际分别为 17.755 和 17.2；调整后毛利率指引约 85%，实际 88%。收入／订单达标，毛利率超标。

g5.en: May 7, 2026 → Q2 2026: revenue 18 ±10% versus 17.806; bookings 19 ±10% versus 16.2, below range; adjusted gross margin about 88% versus 87%; adjusted operating profit 0.635. Mixed delivery.
g5.zh-Hans: 2026 年 5 月 7 日 → 2026 年第二季度：收入指引 18 ±10%，实际 17.806；订单指引 19 ±10%，实际 16.2，低于区间；调整后毛利率指引约 88%，实际 87%；调整后营业利润 0.635。达标情况不一。

g6.en: Pending: August 6, 2026 → Q3 2026 revenue 17 ±10%, bookings 18 ±10%, adjusted gross margin about 88%, adjusted operating expenses 14.5 ±5%. No actual is supplied as of October 19, 2026.
g6.zh-Hans: 待验证：2026 年 8 月 6 日 → 2026 年第三季度收入指引 17 ±10%，订单 18 ±10%，调整后毛利率约 88%，调整后营业费用 14.5 ±5%。截至 2026 年 10 月 19 日，本报告未提供该季度实际结果。

noteTitle.en: Micron note: variable conversion and cash risk
noteTitle.zh-Hans: Micron 票据：浮动转换与现金风险

note.en: The $10m note was issued August 6, 2026, with 8% simple interest on a 360-day basis and scheduled conversion August 7, 2028 (732 elapsed days). Conversion price is the lower of 90% of conversion-date fair value and 115% of the August 5, 2026 Nasdaq close. No verified dollar ceiling or usable numeric Nasdaq issuance capacity is established here. If required approval is unavailable, excess above the permitted shares can settle in cash at hypothetical market-sale value, potentially above principal plus interest. Default acceleration and earlier change-of-control conversion are separate unresolved paths; additional borrowing is restricted by the purchase agreement.
note.zh-Hans: 1,000 万美元票据于 2026 年 8 月 6 日发行，按 360 天基准计收 8% 单利，计划于 2028 年 8 月 7 日转换（相隔 732 天）。转换价取转换日公允价值的 90% 与2026 年 8 月 5 日纳斯达克收盘价的 115% 中较低者。本研究未核实美元计价上限，也未确定可用的纳斯达克发行股数额度。若无法取得必要批准，超出许可股数的部分可能按假设市售价值现金结算，金额可能超过本金加利息。违约加速偿付和控制权变更导致提前转换是尚未解决的独立路径；购买协议亦限制额外借款。

liquidityTitle.en: Dated liquidity stress assumptions, not a funding commitment
liquidityTitle.zh-Hans: 按日期排列的流动性压力假设，并非融资承诺

liquidity.en: The corrected v2 bridge has 126 dated events per case. June 30, 2026 reported cash of 13.000 less a 0.754 contingent-claim reserve and the full 3.600 undiscounted vendor cash reserve leaves 8.646 unrestricted. The 3.323 vendor carrying amount is not a second deduction. Assumed year-end vendor payments only consume the prefunded reserve; exact contractual payment dates are not established. Confirmed note proceeds enter exactly once on August 6, 2026. Any hypothetical cap-excess cash settlement is fully reserved at issuance and paid at the scheduled August 7, 2028 conversion, without duplicate principal or cash deductions. These reserves are analytical encumbrances, not reported restricted-bank balances.
liquidity.zh-Hans: 修订后的 v2 桥接模型每种情景含 126 个日期事件。2026 年 6 月 30 日报告现金 13.000，扣除或有请求权准备 0.754 和全部未折现供应商现金准备 3.600，剩余可用现金 8.646。供应商账面金额 3.323 不会再次扣减。假设年末支付供应商款项时仅使用预留资金；并未确认准确的合同付款日。已确认的票据款项仅于 2026 年 8 月 6 日计入一次。任何假设的超额度现金结算均在发行时全额预留，并于计划转换日 2028 年 8 月 7 日支付，不重复扣除本金或现金。这些准备是分析性资金占用，不是已报告的受限银行余额。

limits.en: Annual operating cash is spread evenly across month ends solely for stress analysis; it cannot establish intra-month solvency. Equity prices, fees and funding availability are synthetic and uncommitted. Future cash, post-August ownership and legal capacity remain unresolved; funding refusal, default, change of control and insolvency recovery are not solved. No numeric operating EV or common-equity allocation is released in this report.
limits.zh-Hans: 年度经营现金仅为压力分析而均匀分摊至各月末，无法证明月内偿付能力。股权融资价格、费用和融资可得性均为假设且无承诺。未来现金、8 月后的股权结构和法律发行额度尚未解决；未解决融资被拒、违约、控制权变更及破产回收情景。本报告不发布数值化经营企业价值或普通股价值分配。

gatesTitle.en: What must change before valuation can be enabled
gatesTitle.zh-Hans: 开放估值前必须解决的事项

gate1.en: Refresh dated cash, post-June burn and ATM settlements, cash restrictions, shares and contingent claims; reconcile the current fully diluted ownership register.
gate1.zh-Hans: 更新按日期排列的现金、6 月后的现金消耗与 ATM 结算、现金限制、股数及或有请求权；核对当前完全摊薄股权登记。

gate2.en: Verify the actual conversion ceiling, Nasdaq capacity and approval status, plus full default and change-of-control economics.
gate2.zh-Hans: 核实实际转换上限、纳斯达克发行额度与批准状态，以及完整的违约和控制权变更经济影响。

gate3.en: Resolve dated liquidity, financing refusal and recovery; allocate ownership at each funding/conversion event rather than assuming survival funding.
gate3.zh-Hans: 解决按日期排列的流动性、融资被拒和回收情景；在每次融资／转换时分配股权，而非假定生存融资必定到位。

gate4.en: Independently review the resulting common-equity bridge, timing and uncertainty before enabling valuation, ranking or simulation.
gate4.zh-Hans: 在开放估值、排名或模拟前，独立审核最终普通股价值桥接、时点和不确定性。

audit.en: Independent v1 and corrected v2 reviews passed segregated research-only admission and held ready valuation. V2 independently replayed three cases and three cash-settlement stresses, each with 126 events, and reran 18 author tests. These checks validate the dated arithmetic and blocking controls, not financing access or a factual price target. Source facts below are curated paraphrases and financial observations, not raw filing copies.
audit.zh-Hans: 独立 v1 与修订 v2 审核均通过独立研究记录准入，但未通过已审核估值准入。V2 独立复算了三种情景和三种现金结算压力情景，每种包含 126 个事件，并重跑了 18 项作者测试。这些检查验证日期计算和阻断控制，并不验证融资可得性或事实性目标价。以下来源内容为整理后的释义与财务观察，并非原始申报文件副本。
